status: Retrospective additional diagnostic, added after observing reference drift and spectral stability, before scoring any new predictions against survey truth. Does not replace the primary protocol.
offline_background: Use R1 first 8 selected cycles and R3 first 12 cycles as two empty references; reserve R1 remaining16 and R3 remaining12 as negative controls. R2 first12 predicts, remaining12 validates. This uses future post-empty data and is an offline analysis, not causal real-time sensing.
models: Compare pooled-rank1 and two-reference-span background-projected MUSIC. At each tone, take dominant eigenvectors of the two training empty covariances and their SVD. Keep two background directions only when sigma2/sigma1>0.05; otherwise one. A target dimension and at least one noise dimension must remain. A 3-element array with two background directions has no noise dimension for rank1 MUSIC and returns unavailable, not an invented angle. 12-element model uses remaining noise dimensions. Calibration options remain raw phase and the explicit R1 direct-path-dominance hypothesis.
validation: Background floor uses only four within-training blocks. Report both held-empty controls, held R2 halves, cross-tree peak consistency, observation-model gates and missing hardware validation. An unavailable empty peak alone is not a proof of background removal; compare projected power and tone availability. No human truth in computation.
synthetic_aperture: Optional software/identifiability checks use invented generic angles, not the five station coordinates. Clearly label simulated and never merge with measured results.
